about_the_game:
A powerful and easy-to-use tool to personalize your visual experience.

• 🚀🖱️ Change atmosphere during gaming or work!

• 👁️ Adjust color and brightness as you wish to protect your eyes!

• 🖼️ Use your JPG/PNG images as screen filters!

• 🎥 Use your MP4/WEBM/AVI/MKV/MOV videos as screen filters!

🎨 Color Filters:

  • Real-time RGB, saturation, brightness adjustment

  • 0-100% transparency control

  • Save your filters to a list

  • Easily apply / rename / delete your saved filters

🖼️ Image Filters:

  • Add JPG/PNG images via drag-and-drop

  • Image transparency adjustment

  • Save your images to a list

  • Easily apply / change opacity / delete your saved images

🎥 Video Filters:

  • Add MP4/WEBM/AVI/MKV/MOV videos via drag-and-drop

  • Video transparency adjustment

  • Save your videos to a list

  • Easily apply / change opacity / delete your saved videos

🕒 Scheduler System

With the Scheduler tab, you can set a specific time to automatically:

  • Toggle the All FilterMob filters on/off

  • Automatically load a saved profile

  • Shutdown PC

  • Restart PC

  • Lock PC

💾 Advanced Profile Management

You can now save every setting (Color, Image, Video, Gamma, and System Brightness) as a named Profile.000

  • Saved profiles are now listed with visual icons (Color previews or thumbnails).

  • Switch between "Game Mode," "Reading Mode," or "Night Mode"... (your profiles) with a single click.

💾 Automatic Save Management:

  • All settings are automatically saved

  • Last used filters and overlays are remembered and automatically set at startup

  • Your settings are safe even in unexpected shutdowns

⚡ Performance

  • Optimized Efficiency:Designed for low resource consumption.

⌨️ Quick Actions:

  • Instant control via customizable global shortcuts (Shift+Esc, F-keys) 

  • Automatic system language detection (30+ languages).

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 1 GHz processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / AMD Radeon R3
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.5 GHz or faster processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or higher
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Transform your screen with FilterMob! Perfect for eye protection, gaming/work atmosphere, and accessibility. Easily apply color, image or ideo filters. Customize RGB, Saturation, Brightness, and Transparency in real time. Save Profiles and Schedule.
